title: S4-FX-01 — The Lamp can be put back.
goal: Applying a lamp to Bun changes its colors as one undoable step: one Undo returns the exact original artwork and one Redo returns the exact lit result.
cliOnly: full native RGBA of the applied and restored rasters

steps.why: The lamp recolors Bun without changing its silhouette.
One Undo restores the original artwork exactly.
One Redo restores the exact lit result.
